newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Jardine Fleming gets seat on Karachi bourse.
newsitem.headline: Jardine Fleming gets seat on Karachi bourse.

text.p: Jardine Fleming Limited said on Friday the board of the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) had accepted its application for membership of the bourse.
The seat has been given to a joint venture between Jardine Fleming's subsidiary Jardine Fleming Pakistan Broking and Jardine Fleming Pakistan Broking Employees Trust.
"Jardine Fleming is delighted by this development," Henry Strutt, chiarman and managing director of Jardine Fleming Ltd, said in a statement.

He said the acquisition of a seat on KSE "underlines our commitment to the sub-continent and to Asia in general and provides Jardine Fleming's clients with a network of broking services stretching from Pakistan across India to South East Asia, the Far East and Australia."
Jardine Fleming now has 27 seats on 18 stock exchanges and a network of 44 offices in 32 cities throughout the Asia Pacific region/ the statement said.
